in_rule_circular.interpretation: On the in-rule panel (10 targets, 30 actives), mean ROC-AUC 1 and top-1 hit rate 100.0% confirm that `TARGET_RULES` lookup behaves as coded — this is a **regression/consistency** check, not evidence of generalization. Docking ΔG baseline (ROC-AUC 0.506, top-1 28.6%) remains near chance and is not part of the 0–100 score.

held_out_non_circular.interpretation: On the held-out panel (10 targets, 30 actives not in rule lists), mean ROC-AUC 0.352 and top-1 hit rate 40.0% (33.2% random expectation) measure **external** behavior. Unlisted actives typically receive only Lipinski/Veber drug-likeness points (~0–24) unless they match `KINASE_INHIBITOR_RE` / class regexes via `drugClass` (we leave `drugClass` empty in the dataset). Same-family kinase inhibitors in the global regex still get ~12 pt demotion bands when listed in `demotedRe`, but novel chemotypes are scored like generic decoys — so separation collapses toward physicochemical tie-breaks. Docking on held-out pairs: ROC-AUC 0.422, top-1 28.6%. TargetForge can honestly claim **curated-rule coverage for known drug names**, not blind discovery of new chemical matter.
held_out_non_circular.suggested_cv_claim: Target-aware ranking separates FDA-listed on-target drugs from off-target decoys for rule-covered targets (in-rule top-1 100.0%); on held-out inhibitors absent from the rule tables, enrichment is modest (ROC-AUC 0.352, top-1 40.0%) and should be paired with docking/assays.

limitations: Small, hand-curated panels — not a substitute for DUD-E or large-scale virtual screens.
In-rule actives mirror `TARGET_RULES` lists (circular); held-out actives are verified absent from those lists via `benchmark/auditRuleLists.mjs`.
Held-out decoys are property-matched (MW, logP, HBD/HBA, rotatable bonds) but not full DUD-E decoy sets.
Potency labels come from ChEMBL / literature citations in `heldout_set.json`, not re-measured in this run.
Co-crystal ligand bonuses still apply when PDB titles mention rule-list drugs (e.g., erlotinib on 1M17).
pipeline_notes: Scored with `rankCandidatesLocal` / `scoreOne` from `src/scoreCandidates.js` (source: heuristic-v2) — identical to local Staging Bench and repurposing batch numeric ranks.
PAINS/toxicophore checks run via `checkPainsFast` on supplied SMILES (same patterns as the bench).
OpenAI `/api/rank-candidates` reasoning is excluded so results stay deterministic and reproducible.
RDKit WASM ADME (`admeCalculator.js`) and organ-toxicity flags are not combined into the 0–100 ranking score in production; they were not applied here.
Native docking baseline uses `runMolecularDocking` (via `src/benchmark/dockingBench.test.js` + RDKit WASM) with searchExhaustiveness=4 and seeded Math.random per (PDB, CID).
